scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
{0} Prisoner #{1}{2},
what's the noise over there?
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
{0} 囚犯#{1}{2}，
那邊在吵什麼？

scripts.text: Let me free, I'll pay!
scripts.translation: 放我出去，我付錢！

scripts.text: Let me to work off my freedom!
scripts.translation: 讓我幹活換取自由！

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
I can't remember you. Is it your 1st time?
You again? Somebody hasn't grown wiser from the very first visit...
OK, we could release you for ^FF0000{0}z^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
我不記得你。第一次來？
又是你？看來第一次進來時還沒學乖...
好吧，交^FF0000{0}z^000000，我們就放你出去。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
好吧，交^FF0000{0}z^000000，我們就放你出去。

scripts.text: I pay cash!
scripts.translation: 我付現金！

scripts.text: Do you accept cheques?
scripts.translation: 你們收支票嗎？

scripts.text: I've changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改變主意了

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
You've got some time to think about...
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
你還有時間考慮一下...

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
OK, sing here and there.
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
好，在這裡和那裡簽字。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
What's this? It's not enough!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
就這麼點？錢不夠！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
OK, sign your cheque. And put down your name in my book.
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
好吧，籤一下支票。然後在我的賬本上寫下你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Your case says nothing about your bank accounts.
Alas, there's your bank account info... ^FF0000{0}z^000000... in the case. It's not enough.
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
你的檔案裡沒有銀行賬戶的記錄。
唉，檔案裡記著你的賬戶餘額...^FF0000{0}z^000000...這點錢不夠。
別再耍這些無聊的把戲了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Alas, there's your bank account info... ^FF0000{0}z^000000... in the case. It's not enough.
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:

別再耍這些無聊的把戲了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Your case says nothing about your bank accounts.
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
你的案卷裡沒有關於你銀行賬戶的資訊。
別再玩這種無聊的把戲了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
別再玩這種無聊的把戲了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
You are free now!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
你現在自由了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Our stocks are short of toadstools.  Remember your morning's skilly?  What about some work at our sponsored mushroom farm?
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
我們的毒蘑菇庫存不夠了。還記得你早上喝的稀粥嗎？要不要去我們資助的蘑菇農場乾點活？

scripts.text: OK, I'll work off!
scripts.translation: 好的，我去幹活！

scripts.text: I love this prison!
scripts.translation: 我愛這座監獄！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
I'm sorry, you should release your Cart, PecoPeco or Falcon!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
抱歉，先卸下手推車，放走大嘴鳥或獵鷹吧！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Talk to our overseer, Oliver.
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
去找我們的監工奧利弗談談。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Is today X-Mas time, huh?
Now shut up and back off!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
今天是聖誕節嗎？
現在閉嘴，退後！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Now shut up and back off!
scripts.translation:
[薩德烏斯]
現在閉嘴，退後！

scripts.text: [Oliver]
scripts.translation: [奧利弗]

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
I want you to gather ^FF0000{0} Orange Net Mushroom^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
我要你採集^FF0000{0}個毒香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
I want you to gather ^FF0000{0} Orange Net Mushroom^000000.
OK... hand me all the shrooms...
Let me see... {1} of almost edible ones...
And {2} useless deadly ones.
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
我要你採集^FF0000{0}個毒香菇^000000。
好...把蘑菇都交給我...
讓我看看...{1}個勉強能吃的...
還有{2}個沒用的劇毒蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Thank you. You are free!
scripts.translation:
[奧利弗]
謝謝。你自由了！

scripts.text:
Hmm... You've been here already... Well-well...
Drop these mushrooms!! They are poisonous!
OK, you must bring me ^FF0000{0}^000000 edible ^FF0000Orange Net Mushroom^000000 toadstoo.. shrooms.
You're a fast fella! You'll have to get more shrooms, then.
And you may eat the deadly ones for breakfast.
scripts.translation:
嗯...你以前來過這裡...好，好...
把這些蘑菇扔掉！它們有毒！
好的，你必須給我帶來^FF0000{0}^000000個能吃的^FF0000毒香菇^000000，毒蘑...蘑菇。
你動作真快！看來你得再採一些蘑菇了。
至於那些致命的，你可以留著當早餐吃。
